verdict.summary: Rice noodle salad can be gluten-free, but there are risks associated with cross-contamination and certain sauces that may contain gluten. Care should be taken to ensure all ingredients and preparation methods are safe for those with coeliac disease.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
